period.label: Period
period.inProgress: In progress — {{days}} of {{total}} days so far

score.title: Life Balance Score
score.noDataHelp: Complete tasks with due dates, check in habits, log learning time or record your mood, and the score will appear.
score.coverage: Based on {{used}} of {{total}} components · {{coverage}}% data coverage
score.disclaimer: A rough guide to balance in this app's data, not a measure of your worth or health. The weights are starting assumptions you can change in Settings.
score.how: Σ (weight × component score) ÷ Σ weight, using only components that are switched on and have data. Missing components are left out instead of counted as zero; coverage shows how much of the score had data.

formula.tasks: Tasks due in the period that were done on time ÷ tasks due in the period. A task due today isn't counted until the day ends. Subtasks and dropped (archived) tasks are left out.
formula.habits: Check-ins done ÷ (scheduled days − skipped days), using the streak rules. Weekly-target habits count min(done, target) per week.
formula.goals_learning: Average of: learning minutes ÷ your weekly learning target (prorated, max 100%), and goals on track = progress ÷ share of time elapsed (max 100%). Goals whose time hasn't started yet are left out.
formula.wellbeing: Average of each day's mood and energy (1–5), rescaled to 0–100. Needs at least 3 check-in days in the period.

metrics.dueBreakdown: {{onTime}} on time · {{late}} late · {{missed}} missed of {{due}} due
metrics.noGoals: Nothing to judge yet. A goal counts once it's active, has progress and a target date, and some of its time has passed.
metrics.estimatesNone: Finish tasks that have an estimate and logged time to see this.
metrics.timeNone: No time logged in this period.

trend.title: Score over the last 8 weeks
trend.noData: No score yet for these weeks.
trend.gap: Weeks without data are left as gaps, not zeros.

settings.title: Life Balance Score
settings.help: Adjust how much each area counts, or switch an area off if it doesn't apply to you.
settings.learningTargetHelp: Leave empty for no target — learning time is still shown, it just isn't scored.
settings.atLeastOne: Keep at least one area switched on.
